summary: Frontend-only test of reduced mobile menu on /pagamento-pix.html and /inscricao-realizada.html (seduc-theme.js v=21). Real mobile emulation (390x844 DPR3 is_mobile/has_touch and Pixel7 393x851 DPR2.75). Both pages: #mnav full height (844/851, top 0, transform none, visible), innerText exactly 'MENU × PÁGINA DE ACOMPANHAMENTO', 0 <li>, only one CTA (/minhas-inscricoes.html). Tapping the CTA navigates to /minhas-inscricoes.html; × and backdrop tap close the menu. Regression: inscricao, dados-inscricao, confirmacao show full menu (6 items + Fazer inscrição + Página de acompanhamento), minhas-inscricoes shows 6 items + Fazer inscrição (acompanhamento intentionally removed), all full height, close via ×/backdrop OK. Desktop 1920: both pages show normal horizontal header (hamburger hidden, 6 nav items + Página de acompanhamento button).

issues: Cosmetic only: with list removed, drawer is mostly empty white space with the CTA pinned at the bottom; acceptable per request, optionally move CTA up under header.

critical_code_review_comments: menu(r) path regex /(pagamento-pix|inscricao-realizada)/ is correct and scoped; no issues found.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Header in open shadow root #seduc-header-host; #mnav/#mnav-backdrop in .mnav-layer (class mnav-on when open). Use browser.new_context with is_mobile/has_touch and DPR>=2; locator('#seduc-header-host').locator('#mnav-open').tap() pierces shadow DOM.
